capabilities.description: Validate an authored SVL/1 JSON file and return its actual semantic digest, operators and graph. This does not run a native engine or place orders.

source_path.description: Workspace path to the authored SVL JSON file

usage.purpose: Validate an authored SVL/1 JSON file and return its actual semantic digest, operators and graph. This does not run a native engine or place orders.
usage.inputs: source_path 是工作区 SVL JSON。语言与合法示例从本插件 skills/strategy-authoring/references/language.md、examples/close-threshold.svl.json 读取。
limitations: 字段/引用错误按 diagnostics 修源；不猜原语或仅改版本号。通过不代表原生回测或交易正确。

capabilities.description: Publish a validated SVL source as an immutable strategy.source artifact. Preserve this exact reference for target translation and future trade evidence.

operation_id.description: Unique idempotency key for this exact publication

artifact_id.description: Existing artifact ID when publishing a new revision

expected_revision.description: Exact current revision when updating an existing artifact

usage.purpose: Publish a validated SVL source as an immutable strategy.source artifact. Preserve this exact reference for target translation and future trade evidence.
usage.inputs: operation_id/source_path/title/change_summary 必填；parent 可保存来源关系；更新已有成果使用 artifact_id+expected_revision。
usage.outputs: {ref,sourceDigest,graph,validationScope:"svl-source-only"}；ref 是后续 replay/graph/目标适配的固定 strategy.source。
prerequisites: 可读取 SVL；发布内部会重新验证，无需为发布机械重复单独校验。
limitations: 同一操作 ID 仅重试相同内容；内容变化用新 ID。发布不执行或交易。

capabilities.description: Read a fixed SVL source artifact and derive its graph from the same validated AST. No layout or explanation is treated as execution evidence.

usage.purpose: Read a fixed SVL source artifact and derive its graph from the same validated AST. No layout or explanation is treated as execution evidence.
usage.inputs: source 是 strategy_publish 的完整 strategy.source 引用。
usage.outputs: 从固定源同一 AST 派生的图节点与连线。
limitations: 不能把手画说明图当执行证据；摘要不符时重新读取正确成果，勿改引用字段。

capabilities.description: Evaluate fixed ordered input events against a saved SVL source. Produces state, intents and actual evaluator traces; it is not a broker simulator, native backtest or translation-equivalence receipt.

fixture_path.description: Workspace JSON with runId, parameters, initialState and ordered events

output_path.description: Optional workspace path for the complete evaluation result

operation_id.description: If provided, preserve this replay as a generic resource artifact

usage.purpose: Evaluate fixed ordered input events against a saved SVL source. Produces state, intents and actual evaluator traces; it is not a broker simulator, native backtest or translation-equivalence receipt.
usage.inputs: source 为固定 SVL；fixture_path 为有序事件 JSON，格式与该源匹配；output_path 可落盘，operation_id 可发布输入/结果证据。参考 examples/close-threshold.replay.json。
usage.outputs: 求值 status、状态/意图/轨迹及 validationScope=fixed-input-svl-evaluation、nativeEngineExecuted=false；请求发布时另含 evidence。
limitations: 固定事件求值不做撮合、费用或券商执行；遇动态类型错误修事件或策略，不用编译成功替代本次结果。

capabilities.description: Check and evaluate a frozen signal → target portfolio → risk → execution fixture. Reads exact artifact references and preserves optional evidence. No model, broker, matching engine or native strategy is executed.

fixture_path.description: Workspace JSON conforming to the plugin pipeline.md fixture contract

output_path.description: Optional workspace path for the complete evaluation result

operation_id.description: If provided, preserve the fixture and result as a resource artifact

usage.purpose: Check and evaluate a frozen signal → target portfolio → risk → execution fixture. Reads exact artifact references and preserves optional evidence. No model, broker, matching engine or native strategy is executed.
usage.inputs: fixture_path 是 references/pipeline.md 的固定信号→目标→风险→执行输入，嵌入完整成果引用；output_path/operation_id 可保存结果与证据。
usage.outputs: 实际阶段求值、validationScope 与可选 evidence；验证输入所属策略，保留 nativeEngineExecuted=false。
prerequisites: 已有固定 strategy.source 与输入引用；输入≤4MiB。
limitations: 不调用模型/经纪商；无效或过期引用修具体输入，不将提议指令当已执行订单。

capabilities.description: Run frozen dynamic-universe selection, actual equal/confidence/inverse-volatility portfolio sizing, hard portfolio risk and a replayable execution ledger. Returns quantities, cash, risk evidence, linked order definitions and proposed commands; never sends orders or invokes a model.

fixture_path.description: Workspace JSON conforming to methods.md workflow schema 1.1

output_path.description: Optional workspace path for the complete workflow and execution checkpoint

operation_id.description: If provided, preserve the frozen input and full result as a resource artifact

usage.purpose: Run frozen dynamic-universe selection, actual equal/confidence/inverse-volatility portfolio sizing, hard portfolio risk and a replayable execution ledger. Returns quantities, cash, risk evidence, linked order definitions and proposed commands; never sends orders or invokes a model.
usage.inputs: fixture_path 使用 methods.md 的 schemaVersion=1.1.0；scope.strategyId 与 strategySource 一致。output_path/operation_id 可保存完整工作流与账本证据。
usage.outputs: 实际品种选择、持仓数量、现金预算、风险结论、订单定义与提议命令/执行检查点，可含 evidence。
prerequisites: 固定策略/数据；数量分配规则和执行事件见 methods.md、execution.md，样例见 examples/method-workflow.js。
limitations: 只重放输入账本，不发送订单或调用模型；未知请求不能当零持仓/零风险。

capabilities.description: Run an isolated versioned Agent signal or risk decision with the configured model and frozen artifact inputs. Submit is asynchronous; status waits optionally, cancel/invalidate retire requests, timeline exports actual saved outputs without new model calls. Never places orders.

request_path.description: Workspace JSON decision request conforming to references/agent-inputs.md

job_id.description: Job ID returned by submit; selects its portfolio run for invalidate/timeline

wait.description: Wait for this one job to finish; cancellation of the tool wait does not cancel the job

as_of_ms.description: UTC time for timeline replay or cancel/invalidate; required for historical invalidation

output_path.description: Workspace JSON path for the saved immutable decision timeline

operation_id.description: Idempotency key to publish a saved timeline as an evidence resource

usage.purpose: Run an isolated versioned Agent signal or risk decision with the configured model and frozen artifact inputs. Submit is asynchronous; status waits optionally, cancel/invalidate retire requests, timeline exports actual saved outputs without new model calls. Never places orders.
usage.inputs: models 列模型；submit 用 request_path，格式见 agent-inputs.md；返回 job.id 后 status/cancel/invalidate/timeline 使用 job_id。wait=true 等该作业，历史 timeline/invalidate 指定 as_of_ms；timeline 可 output_path/operation_id 保存。bridge_start/stop 管理本机适配桥。
usage.outputs: submit/status 返回 id/status/output/decision/error/attempts；timeline 返回已保存判断；models 返回可用模型；bridge_start 返回临时 endpoint/token，bridge_stop 不取消模型作业。
prerequisites: 服务已激活；submit 需要已配置模型与固定输入引用；无对话记忆或工具权限。
limitations: 不下单。等待取消不取消作业，须 cancel；失败按 error 和 failurePolicy 处理，不能把未完成判断当有效信号。桥 token 仅给本机适配器，不写报告/成果。

capabilities.description: Write the versioned declarative SVL quant function module (RSI, ATR, MACD, Bollinger, Donchian, z-score and realized volatility) to the workspace. Embed the whole frozen extension in an SVL 1.2 source; formulas expand into the same graph and replay.

output_path.description: Workspace JSON path for the complete frozen extension object

usage.purpose: Write the versioned declarative SVL quant function module (RSI, ATR, MACD, Bollinger, Donchian, z-score and realized volatility) to the workspace. Embed the whole frozen extension in an SVL 1.2 source; formulas expand into the same graph and replay.
usage.inputs: output_path 指向工作区 JSON；生成固定版本的完整纯函数 extension，可嵌入 SVL1.2。用法见 references/quant-functions.md。
usage.outputs: 实际落盘路径、扩展身份/摘要及可用函数；公式仍由同一 SVL 图展开求值。
limitations: 仅写函数模块，不发布 Artifact、不执行行情或原生指标；保留整个扩展及摘要，不手改单个函数后沿用旧摘要。

capabilities.description: 启动私有决策记录库并标记重启中断的作业。

usage.purpose: 启动私有决策记录库并标记重启中断的作业。
usage.inputs: 宿主 lifecycle.activate 事件；实现使用注入的 storageRoot 与数据/模型端口，不消费业务输入。
usage.outputs: {ready:true,storage?:"plugin-private-sqlite"}；打开私有判断库并恢复重启状态。
prerequisites: 由宿主加载插件时调用。
limitations: 不自动重放中断的模型请求。

capabilities.description: 关闭本地决策桥、取消模型作业并关闭私有记录库。

usage.purpose: 关闭本地决策桥、取消模型作业并关闭私有记录库。
usage.inputs: 宿主 lifecycle.dispose 事件；无业务参数。
usage.outputs: {closed:true}；等待本地桥关闭、作业取消和私有记录库释放。
limitations: 关闭不删除已保存判断，也不撤回外部交易。
